## Example 3.25 {#fv7-example-3-25 .fv-lesson .sphere-lesson }

```{=html}
<p>Show that <span data-math="x^2+y^2+z^2+6x-4y+2z+6=0"></span> is the equation of a sphere and find the coordinates of its centre and its radius. Hence sketch the sphere.</p>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Example 3.25 · p. 75</div>

::: {.notes}
OneNote: (x+3)²−9+(y−2)²−4+(z+1)²−1+6=0, so (x+3)²+(y−2)²+(z+1)²=8. Centre (−3,2,−1), radius √8=2√2. Sketch a sphere, label its centre and a radius, with clearly indicated x,y,z directions. Use a dashed hidden equator for depth. Students already know completing the square; avoid a separate procedural recap unless needed.
:::
